inherits: Every BINDING_CASES scenario in ../binding-suite.mjs keeps its 0.1.0 expectation when the caller is WorkerVersion 0.8.0 and the target is this URL.

cases.name: duplex-stream
cases.rule: A response head does not end the upload; the backend is still reading, so the second chunk is delivered and echoed.

cases.name: early-complete-response
cases.fixture: The backend reads the first upload chunk 'one', sends 200 with body 'done', completes the response and stops reading the request.
steps: Send POST with a ReadableStream body (highWaterMark 0) that enqueues 'one'; its own cancel callback records uploadSourceCancelled. No AbortController, response EOF or adapter bookkeeping may stand in for that callback.
Await the response and read the body to completion.
Await fixture.waitFor("uploadPumpClosed"), the backend's own record that its native upload read ended.
Send an ordinary GET through the same binding.

cases.name: early-bodyless-response
cases.fixture: The backend reads the first upload chunk, sends 204 without a body and stops reading the request.
steps: Send POST with a ReadableStream body (highWaterMark 0) that enqueues 'one'; its own cancel callback records uploadSourceCancelled. No AbortController, response EOF or adapter bookkeeping may stand in for that callback.
Await the source cancel callback and fixture.waitFor("uploadPumpClosed").
Send an ordinary GET through the same binding.

cases.name: early-response-nonsettling-upload
cases.fixture: The backend completes a 200 response with body 'done' but never ends its native upload read; the fixture withholds uploadPumpClosed.
steps: Send POST with a ReadableStream body (highWaterMark 0) that enqueues 'one'; its own cancel callback records uploadSourceCancelled. No AbortController, response EOF or adapter bookkeeping may stand in for that callback.
Read the response body to completion and await the source cancel callback.
Inspect the Host's drain or retirement record for this call.

expect.note: The source cancel and the delivered response are not evidence that the native upload ended; the Host keeps the call unknown/pending for drain and retirement until it confirms the end or cancels it.

cases.name: upload-error-before-completion
cases.fixture: The backend sends a 200 head, echoes 'one', and keeps the response open; the caller's source then errors before the Host observes the response end.
steps: Send POST with a ReadableStream body that enqueues 'one' and keeps the stream open.
Await the 200 head and read the echoed 'one' from the response body.
Only then error the source, before the Host observes the response end.
Read the response body until it settles.
cases.note: An error before the head would instead reject the Promise with request_aborted. A later response completion does not turn the observed upload failure into a clean response.
